text: しょっちゅう　ひとを　からかう　ので　きんじょ　じゃ　モノマネ　むすめと　よばれとる！

structure.jp: しょっちゅう　ひとを　からかう　ので
モノマネ　むすめと　よばれとる！

patterns.name: 〜ので
patterns.explanation: ので gives the reason for what follows. からかう　ので = 'because she teases'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: モノマネ　むすめと　よばれとる
patterns.explanation: よばれる is 'be called' instead of 'call', and と comes after the name she is called. モノマネ　むすめと　よばれとる = 'she is called the Copycat girl'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is a dialect and old-man form of ている, which says something is going on as a lasting state. よばれとる = 'is being called'.
